$schema-note: Structure follows the task contract described in Microsoft Learn, Designing Agent Architecture and SDLC Integration, Unit 3 - inputs, outputs, and success criteria: https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/training/modules/design-agent-architecture-integration/3-inputs-outputs-success-criteria. Learn defines the concept and its three sections and shows them as prose in an issue or pull request. Rendering them as JSON, and the stopConditions extension, are this repository's choices, not a Microsoft standard.
title: Stop duplicate orders after client retries

constraints: no workflow or Actions changes without human approval
no schema change beyond an additive migration
no raw idempotency keys or request payloads in storage or logs

outputs.description: A structured plan in the pull request description
A bounded changeset on an agent branch, inside inputs.scope.allowed
Links to workflow runs and uploaded artifacts

successCriteria.statement: Same key and payload within 24 hours returns the original order
successCriteria.provenBy: replays the original response across instances

successCriteria.statement: Same key with a different payload returns 409
successCriteria.provenBy: rejects a different payload for the same key

successCriteria.statement: Concurrent retries create exactly one order
successCriteria.provenBy: creates exactly one order under concurrent cross-instance retries

successCriteria.statement: Requests without a key preserve current behavior
successCriteria.provenBy: preserves baseline behavior without an idempotency key

successCriteria.statement: Raw keys and payloads are not logged

stopConditions: a workflow, permission, or Actions change is required
a public response field would change
a schema change beyond an additive migration is required
the same required check fails twice with the same failure signature
